tha-ap33:2.1: kālamaññāya padumuttaraṁ mahāmuniṁ mahantiṁ → kālam aññāya padumuttaramahāmuṇiṁ mahantaṁ (pts)
tha-ap33:2.3: mahantiṁ kadalīkaṇṇiṁ → mahantaṁ kadalikaṇṇiṁ (sya-all) | mahantiṁ → mahantaṁ (bj: the, PTS) | kadalīkaṇṇiṁ → G. kandalīkaṇṇiṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap33:2.4: upagacchahaṁ → upagañchahaṁ (bj, pts) | upagacchahaṁ paṭiggahetvā → upagañchahaṁ paṭiggahesi (sya-all)
tha-ap33:3.1: paṭiggahetvā → paṭiggahesi (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu) | Paṭiggahetvā → paṭiggahesi (cck: syā. ka.) | Paṭiggahetvā → G. S1 M. paṭiggahesi. (pts note)
tha-ap33:3.2: phalaṁ → sabbaññu (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu) | sabbaññū → taṁ phalaṁ (cck: sī.) | phalaṁ → G. S1 M. sabbaññū. (pts note)
tha-ap33:4.3: sakāsane → ekāsane (bj: sī.selu) | sakāsane → S1 ekāsane. (pts note)
tha-ap33:5.1: samitāro → samītāro (sya-all) | sametāro → ye ca santi samitāro (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu) | samitāro → ye vasanti sametāro (cck: sī.) | sametāro → G. samītāro; S1 samīkāro. (pts note)
tha-ap33:5.3: bhūtabhabyāni → bhūtagaṇā sabbe (sya-all) | bhūtabhabyāni suṇantu → bhūtabhavyāni sunantu (pts) | bhūtabhabyāni → bhūtagaṇā sabbe (cck: syā.) | bhūtabhavyāni → G. -sabbāni. (pts note)
tha-ap33:6.1: upaṭṭhāsi → yo maṁ upaṭṭhahi poso (bj: the)
tha-ap33:6.2: migarājaṁva kesariṁ → migarājā ca kesarī (bj) | kesarī → migarājaṁva kesariṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | kesariṁ → migarājāva kesarī (cck: sī.) | kesarī → S2 sukesarī. (pts note)
tha-ap33:7.1: ekādasañcakkhattuṁ so → soyamekādasakkhattuṁ (bj) | ekādasañcakkhattuṁ →  (pts) | so → so yam ekādasakkhattuṁ (pts) | so’yamekādasakkhattuṁ → ekādasañcakkhattuṁ so (bj: machasaṁ) | so → soyamekādasakkhattuṁ (cck: sī.) | ekādasakkhattuṁ → G. S1 ekādasañ ca kkhattuṁ so. (pts note)
tha-ap33:7.3: catutiṁsatikkhattuñca → catuttiṁsakkhattuñca (bj) | catutiṁsatikkhattuñca cakkavattī → catuttiṁsatikhattuñca cakkavatti (sya-all) | catuttiṁsakkhattuñca → catuvīsatikkhattuñca (bj: the); catutiṁsati (bj: machasaṁ, sī.selu)
tha-ap33:9.4: labhissati → bhavissati (bj: machasaṁ) | labhissati → bhavissati (cck: ka.)
tha-ap33:10.3: kuṇḍadhānoti → koṇḍadhāno ti (pts) | Koṇḍadhāno → G. Koṇḍatthāno; S1 Kuṇḍhadāno. (pts note)
tha-ap33:12.1: sāvakehi → sāvakaggehi (bj, pts) | sāvakaggehi → sāvakehi (bj: sī.selu, machasaṁ) | Sāvakehi → sāvakaggehi (cck: sī.) | Sāvakaggehi → G. sāvakehi. (pts note)
tha-ap33:13.3: varassa → G. M. varanan tassa; S1 carataṁ tassa; S2 vadataṁ carassa. (pts note)
tha-ap33:14.2: dasasahassikampako → dasasahassīpakampako (bj, sya-all, pts); dasasahassīkampako (cck) | dasasahassīpakampako → S1 M. -sakampako; G. -kappako. (pts note)
tha-ap33:14.4: aggaṭṭhāne → agge ṭhāne (pts) | ṭhāne → G. aggaṭṭhāne. (pts note)
